first.rationale: Activation and onboarding completion are both declining, so a guarded onboarding simplification test directly addresses the two current funnel problems and is supported by prior SMB and self-serve evidence. Verify both records before committing because the experiment could improve completion while reducing qualification data or downstream revenue quality. Promotional pricing may counter competitor pressure, but it does not address the activation and completion declines as directly and could compress sustainable revenue.

final.rationale: Run a standard, segment-targeted onboarding simplification experiment for SMB and self-serve accounts. The current activation and onboarding declines directly match the proven benefits of signup simplification and shortened onboarding: higher activation, completion, faster time-to-value, and improved retention. Monitor qualified revenue and 30-day retention as guardrails, since signup simplification previously produced a small retention decline and its evidence did not generalize beyond SMB. Do not use broad promotional pricing this week because it addresses competitive price pressure but not the simultaneous funnel deterioration and may weaken sustainable revenue.
